context: Desktop: fixed to the viewport bottom, reusing the shared component from rx-ux-01. Mobile: a collapsible fixed bar - compact by default showing count and primary action, expanding on tap - NOT a sticky child of a scroll container. Clearance is measured for both collapsed and expanded heights. Dismissal collapses without clearing the selection.
description:
Geometry slice for the shared selection tray, separate from its accessibility behaviour (rx-ux-16) and from print (rx-ux-20).

Constraint established by review: the app uses document scrolling (Layout.tsx:19) and the named table containers are HORIZONTAL scrollers (e.g. QueryHeatmap.tsx:613). A tray placed inside overflow-x-auto gets the wrong containing block and tracks horizontal offset. A sticky element placed after route content will not be visible until the reader reaches it.

anti_patterns.dont: Rebuild tray placement or clearance measurement from scratch
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD extend the existing component and spec
anti_patterns.why: #1810 already landed a shared CompareTray whose spacer height is measured with a ResizeObserver and asserted in e2e

anti_patterns.dont: clear the selection when the tray is dismissed
anti_patterns.why: dismissal is a display preference, not an intent to discard work

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: place the tray inside a table's overflow-x-auto container
anti_patterns.instead: keep it fixed with its own containing block
anti_patterns.why: it would track horizontal scroll offset and disappear sideways
an expanded tray is taller and would re-cover the last row
